mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, compressing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days without regime-specific triggers.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.3%) and low policy rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) create delayed policy response expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods meeting both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS conditions.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth exceeding 0.5% monthly signals a post-shock economic recovery, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days during recovery phases.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Positive month-over-month nonfarm payrolls growth (PAYEMS increase) indicates strengthening labor markets, consistently producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1,000.0 thousand units signal weak consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 1000.0 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal broad economic weakness, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days through demand-supply feedback loops.
candidate_trigger: HOUST monthly change < 0% AND INDPRO monthly change < 0%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline monthly.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.5%) trigger expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.5%).
